title: Chinese Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch Gai Lan (Chinese broccoli), trimmed | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root
directions: 2. Gather all ingredients. | 3. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook Chinese broccoli in boiling water, uncovered, until just tender, about 4 minutes. | 4. Drain and place in a shallow bowl. | 5. Whisk together hoisin sauce, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a small saucepan over medium heat until sauce is thickened and no longer cloudy, 5 to 7 minutes. | 6. Pour sauce over broccoli; toss to coat and serve.
